description.value: Beere Brewing is a family-run craft brewery on North Vancouver's waterfront, founded by a father-and-son duo who put their own name on every can. The tasting room pours a rotating lineup spanning hazy IPAs, West Coast IPAs, fruit sours, Italian-style pilsners, and a non-alcoholic pale ale. Beer is available to take home by the can or by the keg for private events, with a monthly subscription option for home delivery.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active tasting room and online beer retail store at 312 Esplanade East, North Vancouver, matching the OSM phone (604 983 2163) and address. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, food, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site, so those fields are null. Takeout is confirmed via the online store page and visible in-person retail beer sales at the tasting room.
concerns: OSM name is 'Beere Brewing' but the website header, footer copyright, and all branding use 'Beere Brewing Co.' — minor name discrepancy worth standardizing.
OSM address uses 'East Esplanade' while the website consistently uses 'Esplanade East'; both refer to the same street and location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active craft brewery with a tasting room on the North Vancouver waterfront; a natural rest stop for cyclists riding the Burrard Inlet corridor, with takeout cans available for the road.
